pieces.Text: You have a minor natural psychic ability.

Select one of the following 0-level spells: dancing lights, psychokinetic hand, telekinetic projectile, or telepathic message. You can cast this spell three times per day as a spell-like ability, using your character level as your caster level.
Special: You can select this feat more than once. Each time you do, you must choose a different spell from the list.
